nodes.label: X3DUOM
notes: The X3D Unified Object Model, an XML representation of the X3D architecture used to generate language bindings.

nodes.label: X3DJSONLD
notes: A tool and library for converting and loading X3D JSON encoded files.

nodes.label: W3C
notes: The World Wide Web Consortium, responsible for web standards including WebXR.

nodes.label: X3D 3.0
notes: X3D 3.0 is the initial version of the X3D standard that transitioned VRML to an XML-based architecture.

nodes.label: VRML
notes: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.
